title: rosa canina f. adscita
intro: Rosa canina f. adscita, commonly known as the dwarf dog rose or alpine rose, is a subspecies of the Rosa canina plant. This perennial shrub is prized for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support skin health, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. adscita include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
